The PLL slice has NO ARCS BY DESIGN on both sides: the .tm publishes no PLL timing group (its 0x7cc block is 80 bytes = 5 x 4 floats, byte-identical to GW2A-18.tm, naming the five rPLL outputs CLKOUT/LOCK/CLKOUTP/CLKOUTD/CLKOUTD3 that this die does not have -- UG306E Table 5-2 gives the Arora-V PLL CLKOUT0..6/CLKFBOUT/LOCK), nextpnr installs no PLL cell arc, and the vendor SDF emits all seven CLKIN->CLKOUTn IOPATHs as 0.000:0.000:0.000 (confirmed on sweep runs -0000, -0005, -0011). DS1239E Table 3-18 publishes no CLKIN->CLKOUT delay at all -- only FIN/FPFD/FVCO/FOUT, TLOCKMAX 15 ms, TSTATPHAOFFSET +/-50 ps and jitter. The band compares each vendor PLL arc against a model delay of 0.0, so a future vendor release publishing a non-zero PLL delay fails loudly instead of being skipped. parse_pll returns {} with the reasoning on the record; pll_block() keeps the decoder inspectable.
